attempts.summary: Deployed a fresh 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster (10.5.29/galera-26.4.22) across node1/node2/node3 on AlmaLinux 9 (no MariaDB was pre-installed), loaded application data (appdb.orders), took the entire cluster down for a maintenance window, brought it back with all committed writes intact and all three members serving, then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on every node, proving changed boot identity and full cluster recovery (3/3 Synced, data intact) after each restart.
